summary: For every cyan component, compute its own bounding box and repaint its cells by local region: an inset center of thickness max(2, floor(min(height,width)/4)) becomes yellow 4; the remaining top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right regions become 6, 1, 2, and 3 respectively. Non-cyan cells are preserved.
